name: Not Your Weight
hint: Four takes. Plate p2 up on the gantry reads a recording and NOT you — stand on it yourself and nothing happens at all, so the only way to switch it on is to record a take standing there and let the Echo do the work. It is also the only thing that shuts down the laser at x=31. TAKE 1: stand on p1 (x=4..6); this powers the lift at x=16..20. TAKE 2: Echo A holds p1 so the lift climbs from y=19 to y=12. Run right and board it at about t=1.5s, while its deck is only about 1.2 units above the floor, ride to the top, step across the 1-unit gap onto the gantry at x=21..28, walk to p2 at x=24 and stand. Nothing lights up — that is correct, it ignores you. End the take there. TAKE 3: Echo B is now standing on p2 and the laser goes dark. Walk to p3 (x=9..11) and stand; that opens the door at x=28.5. TAKE 4: A holds the lift, B kills the laser, C holds the door. Run straight along the floor from spawn — doorway at x=28.5 is open, the laser lane at x=31 is dead, and the exit is at x=35. You never need the lift on the last take; it was only ever there to deliver the body that is standing on that plate.

dialogue.text: The plate does not register you. It registers a recording.

dialogue.speaker: ECHO-0
dialogue.text: Then go up there and become one.
